name: Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon (33rd ed.)
short_description: A 33rd-edition marathon event in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand, held September 27, 2026, offering full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 4.5km distances.
ai_summary: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon returns for its 33rd edition on September 27, 2026, in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand. Runners can choose from four distances: a full marathon (42.195km), a half marathon (21.1km), a 10km race, and a 4.5km fun run. Registration for the event is currently open, making it accessible to a wide range of participants from elite marathoners to casual runners.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 4.5km) suit varying fitness levels
Long-running event history as the 33rd edition suggests established organization
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to plan and prepare
Located in Pattaya, a well-known Thailand destination

excerpt_quotes.quote: 32C so hot and humid! It is a small event with 400 runners. Water each 2K so very well catered given the heat.
Not the best route but mostly flat and crowds at the start and finish. Good food choice at the end too.
Unfortunately for the worst. In 90s the course was pretty much flat. Now lots of up grades and especially at end a hill of 20% grade. No PR will be made here.
With heat &humidity it's probably the most difficult Marathon or half marathon to run.
The weather was extremely hot. Even with wind from the beach, it was still very humid
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Lodkeo Inthakoumman, half-marathon winner, quoted in Laotian Times

research_highlights: Race is held in July with a very early start (around 3:30 AM for the full marathon) to beat the heat, though temperatures still reach around 32°C (84°F) with 90% humidity
Course starts and finishes at Terminal 21 Pattaya, running through Jomtien Beach Road, Sukhumvit highway, and Pattaya Beach Front Road with a mix of flat and rolling terrain
One reviewer noted the full marathon has a hill of roughly 20% grade near the end that has slowed even professional runners by 25-35 minutes compared to earlier flatter editions
Aid stations are frequent (roughly every 2km) with water and some fruit, which reviewers described as well catered for the heat
The event has grown substantially, with 2025 edition drawing a reported 20,250 entrants across all categories including full marathon, half marathon, 10K, wheelchair 4.5km and family run
research_watchouts: Heat and humidity are consistently cited as the toughest part of the race, with one runner reporting conditions around 32°C and high humidity even along the beach breeze
The course has become hillier over the years according to a long-time participant, making it unsuitable for chasing a personal record
A disrupted sleep schedule and unpredictable weather were noted challenges by a competitive finisher due to the pre-dawn start time
Registration can close quickly - one reviewer noted 2025 entries closed within two days of opening

faqs.question: When is the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon, now in its 33rd edition, is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. It will be held in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand, giving participants a full year in advance to prepare their training schedules and travel arrangements for this established annual running event.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance options at the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 4.5km fun run, making the event accessible to runners of many different experience and fitness levels.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Pattaya Marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon is currently open. Interested runners can sign up now for their preferred distance, whether it's the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 4.5km option, ahead of the race date on September 27, 2026, in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon takes place in Pattaya, located in Chonburi, Thailand. This coastal city serves as the venue for all four race distances offered at this event, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 4.5km races, as part of the marathon's 33rd edition.
